pit_message

Central log message repository in various languages.

Fields
pms_name

Unique message name. Used to reference the message as a constant in package MSG.

pms_pmg_name

Unique message group name. Reference to PIT_MESSAGE_GROUP.

pms_pse_id

Severity of the message. Reference to PIT_MESSAGE_SEVERITY.

pms_custom_error

Optional pointer to an Oracle error number. If null, no exception will be generated. To define custom errors, use -20000.

pms_active_error

Effective error number processed by PIT_ADMIN.CREATE_MESSAGE_PACKAGE. Remains null if no custom error is configured.
